baseline: Run the same brief through the ambient router's select.md and record its manifest. team-build must match expect_manifest on more briefs than select does, or it fails as a whole.

evals.prompt: build the team for this project
which skills should this project use?
set up the capabilities for my podcast folder, here's the README
I just stamped .aai into this folder, pick what it needs from the library
use the writer skill on these notes
draft a LinkedIn post about agent teams

evals.note: lifecycle; team-build may run after, not instead

evals.prompt: Run team-build on every brief in evals/briefs.yaml with id 1 to 14, answering inline questions from inline_answers and treating user_scope as the user manifest.
evals.pass_criteria: For each brief: the written manifest equals expect_manifest as a set (order ignored); every labeled pick appears in that need's stage 2 shortlist (recall at 5); each recorded reason names the labeled runner_up or a concrete difference from it; needs marked dropped appear in the rationale record as dropped with the stated cause; brief 14 asks exactly three inline questions before stage 1 and never writes to the user manifest. Report per brief PASS/FAIL per criterion, no aggregate score.

evals.prompt: Run team-build on briefs 15 to 20 in evals/briefs.yaml.
evals.pass_criteria: For each near-miss brief the manifest equals expect_manifest and the recorded reason for the pick states the distinction in the brief's split line in substance (not verbatim). A pick of the runner_up fails the brief. A reason that calls the two candidates interchangeable fails unless team-build asked the user instead of choosing.

evals.prompt: Run team-build on brief 1 twice in fresh contexts.
evals.pass_criteria: Both runs produce the same manifest as a set and the same gaps. Per need, each run's runner_up is in the other run's stage 2 shortlist; the runner-ups need not be identical, since ranking among siblings is a reader judgment and the manifest is the deliverable.
